title: Cruisin Tikis Marathon - Sunset Tiki Cruise
includes: Flip N' Float rafts for swimming
Radio to stream music of your choice
Yeti Cooler with ice and bottled water
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Ready for the most beautiful 2 hours of your Florida Keys vacation?

Forget crowded piers and noise—imagine yourself drifting peacefully as the sun melts into the beautiful water of the Florida Keys. Our 2-Hour Sunset Tiki Cruise transforms the spectacular Keys sunset into a private, moving masterpiece just for you.

The Magic of the Sunset Cruise:

Front-Row Seat to Nature’s Show: Glide across the tranquil, crystal-blue waters as the sky ignites in a breathtaking palette of reds, oranges, and pinks. You'll have the best, unobstructed view of the legendary Keys sunset from the comfort of your floating tiki bar.
A Toast to Paradise: Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply savoring a perfect day, the sunset hour is magical. Bring your favorite beverages to toast the end of a perfect day as the stars begin to appear over the horizon.

Secure your spot now and create a memory that will glow long after the sun goes down!
